matches.rationale: No finding addresses the malformed concatenation/indexing in the unimodal-cross-modal decomposition equation (Eq. 3); the single finding concerns a different equation's scaling factor.

Finding 1 identifies that the attention equations are normalized by sqrt(N_t) (token count) instead of sqrt(d) (feature dimension), which is exactly the mechanism described in gt_id 2, even though it locates this in Appendix B rather than Section 2.2.2 — the same underlying equation/defect appears to be at issue per R1/R3.
No finding addresses the inconsistent application of matrix B to the zero vector in Equation (13)'s cross-modal adaptation term.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Correctly identifies the sqrt(N_t) vs sqrt(d) scaling inconsistency, matching gt_id 2's defect even though it cites a different (possibly appendix-duplicated) location.
